titleText: JTF News: ABC News Australia, BBC News
mainText: Japan executed a man convicted of killing five people in a pachinko parlor fire.
Jurors heard testimony that a nephew of the defendant fired fatal shots at Tupac Shakur in a 1996 drive-by shooting.
